Build the technology behind the teams transforming construction

At XYZ Reality https://www.xyzreality.com, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we’re not only evolving the technology our customers use, we’re also investing in the tools and applications that enable our own teams to operate effectively as we grow.

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of the internal applications, dashboards and AI-enabled tools that help power XYZ Reality behind the scenes.



The Role

This is a great opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building useful products, solving real business problems and owning what they create from idea through to production.

As XYZ has grown, teams across the business have increasingly developed applications, dashboards, automations and AI-enabled tools to solve problems and improve how they work. We now need an engineer who can bring technical ownership to this space – taking promising ideas and prototypes and turning them into scalable, maintainable, production-quality applications.

You’ll work directly with teams across XYZ to understand what they need, translate those requirements into technical solutions and build applications that people across the business will genuinely use.

You'll make sure everything you build meets our engineering, security and data protection standards from the outset.

This is a role with plenty of autonomy. You’ll own applications end-to-end, from architecture and data model through to UI, deployment, monitoring and ongoing iteration.

And when internal priorities allow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your Full Stack skills to our wider product engineering team and the technology behind XYZ Reality’s engineering-grade AR platform.

The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, ideally 2–3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work directly with the teams you’ll be building for while retaining flexibility.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - Design, build and maintain internal business applications end-to-end, from data model and architecture through to user interface.

 - Take ownership of prototypes, dashboards and tools and evolve them into reliable, maintainable applications.

 - Ship quickly using modern serverless and Backend-as-a-Service platforms such as Vercel, Supabase and Firebase.

 - Build applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js and Node.js.

 - Integrate AI capabilities, including LLM APIs, automation and agents, to improve and streamline business workflows.

 - Work directly with stakeholders across XYZ to understand problems, gather requirements and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.

 - Own the full application lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, maintenance and iteration.

 - Ensure appropriate security and data protection standards are built into applications handling employee, user or customer information.

 - Implement authentication, SSO and identity management where required.

 - Champion good engineering practices across code quality, testing, security and CI/CD.

 - Build integrations between internal systems, data sources and third-party platforms.

 - Use feedback and usage data to continually improve the applications you build.

 - Evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities and identify where they can genuinely improve how XYZ operates.

 - Contribute to our wider product engineering environment when capacity allows.

What We’re Looking For

 - Demonstrable in-depth professional software engineering experience, ideally within a Full Stack role.

 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web development.

 - Hands-on experience with React/Next.js and Node.js.

 - Experience building and deploying applications using platforms such as Vercel, Supabase, Firebase or equivalent modern technologies.

 - Experience owning applications beyond the initial build – including deployment, maintenance, monitoring and ongoing improvement.

 - Comfortable integrating AI/LLM services into applications and using modern AI tooling as part of your development workflow.

 - Experience implementing authentication and identity management, such as OAuth/OIDC, SAML or SSO.

 - A good understanding of application security and how to appropriately handle sensitive business and user data.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, with an appreciation for maintainable code, testing and good development practices.

 - Comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning their requirements into effective technical solutions.

 - Able to work autonomously, prioritise effectively and take ownership of the applications you build.

Experience within a startup, scale-up or modern technology environment would be particularly valuable, as would experience with Postgres/SQL, row-level security, data visualisation, reporting or workflow automation.

We’re looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer with solid fundamentals who is comfortable learning new tools and making pragmatic technology choices based on the problem being solved.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who enjoys building things that make a difference, an engineer who can take an idea or prototype, understand the problem behind it and turn it into technology the business can rely on.



What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you could be working across projects including:

 - Internal business applications and operational tools

 - AI-enabled workflows and automation

 - Business dashboards and reporting

 - Employee and talent applications

 - Data-driven internal tools

 - Integrations between business platforms

 - Prototypes that need to evolve into scalable, production-ready applications

As our internal technology needs continue to evolve, so will the problems you have the opportunity to solve.



Why Join Us

 - 🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

 - 🏠 Hybrid working from our London office

 - 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

 - 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

 - 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days

 - 🪙 Biannual salary reviews

 - 🥳 Summer & Christmas company events

 - 🍣 Free Thursday lunch and after-work gatherings

 - 💰 Employee referral scheme

 - 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

If you’re a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, shipping useful technology and using modern tools to solve real-world problems, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

- 3+ years of experience in data intensive environments 

- Hands-on experience building industrial-strength software

- Solid computer science fundamentals, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture

- Experience with large code bases

- B.Sc in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent practical experience

- Experience in developing database systems is a plus

- Interest in the theory and practice of database query engines. Hands-on experience or M.Sc./Ph.D in the domain is a plus

Position Expectations

- Understand and improve current functionality of the MongoDB query engine

- Identify, design, implement, test, and support new features related to query performance and robustness, query language enhancements, diagnostics for query performance problems, and integration with other products and tools

- Work with other engineers to coordinate seamless changes in a feature-rich, large code base

- Work with other teams including client drivers, cloud services, enterprise tools, support, consulting, education, and marketing to coordinate changes or contribute to their projects

Success Measures

- In three months you’ll have contributed to the development of a project slated for the next major version, as well as fixed a few bugs in a minor version of our latest stable release series

- In six months, you’ll have taken on code review responsibilities and are involved in reviewing the design for new features

- In twelve months, you’re making significant contributions to the development of a new major features

At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.
Summary
We are seeking a qualified Litigation Assistant to join our team. As a Litigation Assistant, you will be responsible for managing the law firm's day-to-day operations, including carrying out administrative services and supporting the legal team. This position's ideal candidate has a strong work ethic, exceptional problem-solving skills, and comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic workplace.
Responsibilities
Perform administrative duties (scheduling calendar hearings and deadlines, organize case files, manage logistics)
Maintain pleadings and discovery indexes.
Organize exhibits, documents, evidence, briefs, and appendices.
Implement and improve upon administrative processes for more efficient workflow.
Collect, examine, and organize evidence and other legal documents for attorney review and case preparation
Draft and proofread correspondence and legal documents, such as pleadings and contracts
Research regulations, laws, and legal articles to assist with the preparation of reports, case files, and legal advice
Manage client billing by preparing, finalizing, and sending out bills, as well as resolving billing issues in cooperation with the billing attorney
Communicate with clients and witnesses to schedule meetings, interviews, and depositions
Manage, organize, and maintain documents in paper or electronic filing systems
Performs other related duties as assigned to meet the needs of the business.
Qualification
High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required.
Associates degree in paralegal studies, a paralegal certificate, or a bachelor's degree is preferred.
Bilingual English and Spanish
At least 2 years of experience as an administrative assistant (preferably in a law firm or in a corporate legal department), legal assistant, legal secretary, or paralegal.
Experience in Personal Injury, WC, Premises, or other injury related practice areas. (preferred)
Must possess the ability to multi-task, prioritize, handle a fast-paced environment, and manage workload with a great attitude and minimal supervision.
Great written and communication skills, be proficient in calendar depositions, mediation, and hearings.
Applicable knowledge of motions, discovery, evidence, litigation documentation, court rules, and procedures, practices, etc.
Highly organized with the ability to juggle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Strong writing and communication skills along with attention to detail
Extensive computer and database expertise, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and type no less than 35 wpm
This role is on-site, which gives you the chance to be fully immersed in the work and gain direct experience alongside the team .
